From 47 CFR 97.207(a) (AMDDATE 2026-08-13), addressing: What frequencies are eligible for amateur space station operation under 47 CFR 97.207?

Any amateur station may be a space station. A holder of any class operator license may be the control operator of a space station, subject to the privileges of the class of operator license held by the control operator.
